  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_InventoryRestocking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-restocking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupplierOrder" name="Supplier order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryRestocking" name="Inventory restocking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Inventory monitoring begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Reorder threshold reached?" default="Flow_BelowThreshold">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThresholdReached</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalChoice" name="Choose reorder signal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThresholdReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ManualCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SendAlert" name="Send automated reorder alert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Alert_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual reorder check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ManualCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Manual_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Merge reorder signals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Alert_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Manual_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place supplier order considering cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability" messageRef="Message_SupplierOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_UpdateExpectedDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDate" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_UpdateExpectedDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateDate_ReceiveStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateDate_ReceiveStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RestockSplit" name="Carry out restocking activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Destination</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock for quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in inventory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageChoice" name="Choose stock destination">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Destination</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceInStorage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOnShelves" name="Place stock on shelves">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Shelves_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInStorage" name="Place stock in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceInStorage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Storage_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Merge destination paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Shelves_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Storage_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Destination_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RestockJoin" name="Restocking activities complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Destination_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_UpdateLevels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_UpdateLevels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated" name="Inventory levels updated after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Gateway_SignalChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockAtOrBelowReorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThreshold" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedAlert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_SendAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alert_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SendAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_UpdateExpectedDate" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDate_ReceiveStock" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDate" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Gateway_RestockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Inspect" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockSplit" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Record" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockSplit" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Destination" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StorageChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Join" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Gateway_RestockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Join" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Gateway_RestockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOnShelves" name="Shelves" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceInStorage" name="Storage" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceInStorage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shelves_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Storage_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInStorage" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RestockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockJoin" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_InventoryRestocking">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_WarehouseStore" name="Warehouse or store">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Monitoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Threshold</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SignalChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAlert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManualCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SignalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateExpectedDate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RestockSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectQuality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StorageChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceInStorage</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DestinationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RestockJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventoryLevels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_InventoryUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ProcurementTeam" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryRestocking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WarehouseStore" name="Warehouse or store" processRef="Process_InventoryRestocking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SupplierOrder" name="Supplier order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Supplier" messageRef="Message_SupplierOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Supplier" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
